name: roam-selftest
title: The in-Roam runner drives a build it loaded itself
claim: A proof page loads its build, runs palette commands, keys, recipes and fixtures from inside Roam, and takes a person's verdict.
given: Sync and node sharing are off, so the build stays off the hosted database.

prepare.why: sync and node sharing are off, so the build doesn't connect this graph to the hosted database

apply.js: (async () => { await proof.flags.set('Suggestive mode overlay enabled', false); await proof.flags.set('Enable node sharing', false); })()
proof.page.ensure('proof/runner scratch', ['A page the runner self-test opens. Leave it in place.'])

cases.title: The page's build loaded and DG is ready

expect.js: proof.assert(typeof window.roamjs?.extension?.queryBuilder?.runQuery === 'function' && typeof window.roamjs.extension.queryBuilder.getDiscourseNodes === 'function', 'DG did not finish loading.')

cases.title: Discourse settings open from the command palette

steps.why: open the settings the way a user would

expect.js: proof.assert(proof.dialogs().length > 0, 'The settings dialog did not open.')

steps.why: press Escape, as Blueprint expects it

expect.js: proof.assert(proof.dialogs().length === 0, 'A dialog is still open after Escape.')

cases.title: A recipe opens the scratch page
cases.checks: its title shows in the main window

expect.js: proof.assert(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.roam-article .rm-title-display')).some((el) => el.innerText.trim() === 'proof/runner scratch'), 'The scratch page is not open.')

cases.title: A case a person does and judges
cases.intent: Look at the panel in the right sidebar: it shows this case as done by hand. Press Done.

expect.text: The panel showed this case with a Done button, and kept its place in the sidebar.
